title: A universal construction of $p$-typical Witt vectors of associative rings
summary: For a prime $p$ and an associative ring $R$ with unity, there are various constructions of $p$-typical Witt vectors of $R$, all of which specialize to the classical $p$-typical Witt vectors when $R$ is commutative. These constructions are endowed with a Verschiebung operator $V$ and a Teichmüller map $\langle \cdot \rangle$, and they satisfy the property that the map $x \mapsto V\langle x^p\rangle - p\langle x \rangle$ is additive.
